originalTitle: Growing proof that autonomous cars save lives
content:
Self-driving tech could prevent 580,000 deaths every year

Lawrence Ulrich is an award-winning auto writer and former chief auto critic at The New York Times and The Detroit Free Press.

Video captured by Rivian technicians shows, in red, areas scanned by lidar during a test drive.
